title: feat: add the ip slot durable object to the legacy text cache (unused)
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added an unused per-IP free-generation slot to the legacy text cache Worker, in preparation for moving the legacy text and image APIs off the OVH VM. The SQLite-backed IpSlot Durable Object preserves the VM rule: while a free generation runs or waits, another text stream gets 429 “Queue full” and a non-stream text or image request gets 402. After it ends, a stream can wait out the remaining 30-second or 45-second interval; non-stream requests still get 402 until the interval ends. Holds expire after 5 minutes if release never arrives, and an alarm cleans up storage unless a new booking arrived. Per-isolate booking memoization lets busy non-stream requests return `pay` without a Durable Object call. Added the `IP_SLOT` binding and SQLite migration, changed the compatibility date to `2025-11-01`, and moved tests from Node to vitest in workerd so they can load `cloudflare:workers`; 25 tests pass, including 9 for IpSlot. As the text cache’s first Durable Object migration, this makes pre-migration versions unavailable as rollback targets.
